# fortiappseccloud_waf_waiting_room

Configures waiting room for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/waiting_room`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_waiting_room` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_waiting_room`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_waiting_room" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status                    = true
    path                      = "/.*"
    enable_total_active_users = true
    total_active_users        = 1000
    enable_new_users_per_min  = false
    new_users_per_min         = 60
    session_duration          = 5
    custom_wt_page            = "Predefined"

    bypass_rules {
      item {
        rule_type  = "source-ip"
        rule_value = "192.0.2.10"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `custom_wt_page` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Custom wt page. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `enable_new_users_per_min` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Enable new users per min for waiting room. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `enable_total_active_users` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Enable total active users for waiting room. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `new_users_per_min` (Optional, Computed) — Sets New users per min. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `path` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Path. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `session_duration` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Session duration. Between 1 and 30. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables waiting room. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `total_active_users` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Total active users. Omission preserves the current value.
  - Cross-field constraints:
    - `total_active_users` must be between 200 and 100000000 when its enabling condition is true.
    - `new_users_per_min` must be between 60 and 100000000 when its enabling condition is true.
    - `new_users_per_min` must be less than or equal to `total_active_users` when the documented enabling condition is true.
  - Collection ownership — Each block below contains ordered `item` blocks. Omitting a collection block preserves the complete raw remote array and keeps the block null in state. A present empty block sends `[]`. A present block with items replaces the complete array in Terraform order.
    - `bypass_rules` (Optional Block, at most 100 items) — Owns the ordered `bypass_rules.item` blocks.
      - `bypass_rules.item.rule_type` (Required, maximum 64 UTF-8 characters, matching `source-ip`, one of `source-ip`) — Rule type.
      - `bypass_rules.item.rule_value` (Required) — Rule value.

The wire-only `idx` field is never exposed. The provider regenerates sequential one-based indices independently for each list, validates imported or owned response indices, and sorts state by `idx`. Unknown nested item keys fail closed for owned and imported arrays; omitted top-level collection wrappers remain opaque and are preserved unchanged.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_waiting_room.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
